newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse index leaps on MSCI index change.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse index leaps on MSCI index change.

text.p: Portuguese blue chips soared in early trade on Friday, with the PSI20 rising over three percent, after Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) announced late Wednesday it was promoting the country to developed market status, dealers said.
Banco Comercial Portugues BCPIN.IN was gaining nearly six percent at 2,800 escudos, while Portugal Telecom was up nearly four percent.
"The foreigners leaped in with orders 'at best' because of the ratings change," said one trader.
MSCI said on Wednesday that because of Portugal's economic progress and growing market liquidity, it was switching the country from its emerging market index with effect from December 2.
Analysts had long been expecting the change which will immediately make Portugal more attractive to international fund managers who often base investment decisions on the various MSCI ratings.
Dealers said that blue chip stocks had the most to gain from the decision because these were the shares international funds would buy in raising their weightings in the Portuguese market.
